rule: Exploratory candidates must exceed both flanking control QPS values and their mean by at least 2 percent. Smaller changes remain available but are excluded from the initial final combination. This is a selection rule, not a statistical test. Extra candidates use the same rule; matched_pool controls also enable lazy_route_opts. Compiler choice requires at least 2 percent vs post O2 control plus consistency with the nearby pre-compiler O2 controls; otherwise retain O2. Report final independent paired runs without selecting a best round.
compiler_threshold_detail: Before inspecting compiler samples: require QPS > both BASE extra controls and post compiler O2 control, and >= 1.02 * post compiler O2 control. If both O3 variants qualify choose higher observed QPS for independent final validation; otherwise O2.
additional_compiler_variant: O3-lto-local adds -fno-semantic-interposition to the same shared-module compiler experiment; no more runtime candidates. It gets full core checks plus stable single-plugin checks and its own 60s post O2 control. Apply the same 2 percent rule before inspecting its QPS.
